fit_line: Next.js and React developer with 3 years of full-stack experience, SEO-friendly server-rendered projects, Tailwind CSS and Stripe/REST integrations, available immediately.

screening_answers.question: How many years of Next.js experience do you have?
screening_answers.answer: I have 3 years of professional full-stack experience and have built several Next.js apps: PageForge (Next.js 16, React 19), Lumen, Kilnwood Roasters, Cairnmoor and contractor-ai-ops-dashboard. I'd be glad to walk through the code.

screening_answers.question: Explain your experience with SSR, SSG and API Routes.
screening_answers.answer: I've built server-rendered, SEO-friendly pages with JSON-LD, plus programmatic SEO on a static-generated site (neuronetwrks.com). My Next.js projects connect to REST APIs and services such as Supabase, Sanity, HubSpot and PostHog. I can go through specific routes in an interview.

screening_answers.question: Which CSS frameworks have you used?
screening_answers.answer: Mainly Tailwind CSS (v4 in PageForge and Safey Inventory) with shadcn/ui, plus plain CSS. I haven't used styled-components professionally, but CSS-in-JS is a small step from my component-based work.

screening_answers.question: How do you test your code?
screening_answers.answer: I write end-to-end API tests for backend flows: 10 on my portfolio backend and 9 on Orbital Surplus, covering bookings, stock holds and payment confirmation. I also use GitHub Actions for CI.

screening_answers.question: What are your salary expectations and notice period?
screening_answers.answer: Notice period: Immediate. I'm in IST (UTC+05:30) and happy to overlap with your team's hours. Salary expectation: to be confirmed by me.

needs_you: Confirm remote work is open to India-based candidates.
State the monthly salary expectation (floor INR 30,000).
Confirm working-hours overlap expected by the team.
knockout_warnings: Posting says only 'Remote'; India eligibility is not stated. Confirm before investing time.
Asks for styled-components as an example of CSS-in-JS; his experience is Tailwind CSS.

paragraphs: I'm applying for the Next.js Developer role at OneClickDrive.com. I have 3 years of professional full-stack experience at a US-based medical-device company, where I built web applications and a CRM, and I now build Next.js and React products in TypeScript with Tailwind CSS.

Your focus on server-rendered, SEO-friendly apps matches my work. PageForge is a Next.js 16 and React 19 app that integrates Sanity, Supabase, PostHog and HubSpot. My portfolio backend has server-rendered SEO with JSON-LD, Stripe bookings with signed webhooks, and 10 end-to-end API tests. I use Git and GitHub Actions day to day.
I'm available immediately and work from Pune on IST (UTC+05:30). My portfolio is at hussain-singapuri.vercel.app and my code is at github.com/huss2003. I'd welcome the chance to discuss the role.
